content.json:
# Logic App Logs

Logic App workflow diagnostics covering run success/failure rates, action-level errors, trigger health, and run duration trends.

content.query:
// Logic App workflow runs — success vs failure trend
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC'
| where Category == 'WorkflowRuntime'
| where OperationName == 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowRunCompleted'
| summarize
    Succeeded = countif(status_s == 'Succeeded'),
    Failed    = countif(status_s == 'Failed'),
    Cancelled = countif(status_s == 'Cancelled')
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Workflow Runs Over Time (Succeeded / Failed / Cancelled)

content.query:
// Per-workflow success rate
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC'
| where Category == 'WorkflowRuntime'
| where OperationName == 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowRunCompleted'
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Succeeded = countif(status_s == 'Succeeded'),
    Failed = countif(status_s == 'Failed')
    by Resource
| extend SuccessRate = round(100.0 * Succeeded / Total, 1)
| order by Total desc
| project Workflow = Resource, Total, Succeeded, Failed, SuccessRate
content.title: Workflow Success Rate

content.query:
// Failed actions — top errors by action name
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC'
| where Category == 'WorkflowRuntime'
| where OperationName == 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionCompleted'
| where status_s == 'Failed'
| summarize FailCount = count() by Resource, resource_actionName_s, error_code_s
| top 25 by FailCount desc
| project Workflow = Resource, Action = resource_actionName_s, ErrorCode = error_code_s, FailCount
content.title: Top Failed Actions by Error Code

content.query:
// Action failures trend over time
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC'
| where Category == 'WorkflowRuntime'
| where OperationName == 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowActionCompleted'
| where status_s == 'Failed'
| summarize FailCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Action Failures Over Time

content.query:
// Trigger outcomes — fired vs skipped vs failed
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC'
| where Category == 'WorkflowRuntime'
| where OperationName has 'workflowTriggerCompleted'
| summarize
    Fired   = countif(status_s == 'Succeeded'),
    Skipped = countif(status_s == 'Skipped'),
    Failed  = countif(status_s == 'Failed')
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Trigger Outcomes Over Time

content.query:
// Workflow run duration percentiles over time
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.LOGIC'
| where Category == 'WorkflowRuntime'
| where OperationName == 'Microsoft.Logic/workflows/workflowRunCompleted'
| where isnotempty(duration_s)
| extend DurationSec = totimespan(duration_s) / 1s
| summarize
    P50 = percentile(DurationSec, 50),
    P95 = percentile(DurationSec, 95),
    P99 = percentile(DurationSec, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Workflow Run Duration (seconds) — P50 / P95 / P99
